title: DA3408 A4 - Image Captioning Observability
description: CPU captioning health, workload, latency, and Ubuntu VM resources. AI assistance prompt: Generate a Grafana dashboard for caption_* and node_exporter metrics. Include health, counts, throughput, histogram percentiles, Summary mean, errors, active jobs, client buckets, model memory, and CPU/RAM correlation with bulk jobs. Use correct units, explicit legends, and descriptions. Presentation update prompt: Add short visible subtitles, explicit linear scale labels, inclusive colors, distinct dash patterns, legends and self-explanatory descriptions. Preserve existing metric queries and the 5-second refresh interval. Query explanations: AI_PROMPTS_DASHBOARD.md.

panels.title: Application metrics UP | scrape health
panels.description: 1 = metrics endpoint reachable; 0 = scrape failed. This does not independently test the browser UI.

panels.title: Node exporter UP | system scrape health
panels.description: 1 = Ubuntu system metrics reachable; 0 = scrape failed.

panels.title: Model ready | loaded on CPU
panels.description: 1 = shared CPU model loaded. Zero before its first successful load.

panels.title: Successful images | since app start
panels.description: Successful image attempts since the application process started.

panels.title: Failed images | since app start
panels.description: Failed image attempts, including image validation failures.

panels.title: Active jobs | running + queued
panels.description: Jobs currently running or waiting for the shared model.

panels.title: Successful throughput | 1-minute rate
panels.description: Successful images per second, averaged over one minute. Idle periods approach zero.

panels.title: Image attempts by mode and outcome | since app start
panels.description: Cumulative attempts since process startup. A restart resets these counters.

panels.title: Inference latency: p50 / p95 / p99 | 5-minute estimates
panels.description: Estimated percentiles over five minutes, across successful inference calls. Excludes queue wait. No observations means no percentile, not zero latency.

panels.title: Mean image duration: Summary | 5-minute mean
panels.description: Five-minute mean = rate(_sum) / rate(_count). Includes validation, queue wait, and failed image attempts. Undefined when no attempts occur.

panels.title: CPU utilisation and bulk activity | VM % vs. bulk jobs
panels.description: Ubuntu VM utilisation on the left axis; active bulk jobs on the right. Compare their timing to inspect correlation. Other VM processes also use resources.

panels.title: RAM utilisation and bulk activity | VM % vs. bulk jobs
panels.description: Ubuntu VM utilisation on the left axis; active bulk jobs on the right. Compare their timing to inspect correlation. Other VM processes also use resources.

panels.title: Root disk utilisation | available-space basis
panels.description: Percentage unavailable to a normal user on Ubuntu's root filesystem, including reserved blocks; follows available-space semantics.

panels.title: Application RAM and model parameters | RSS vs. weights
panels.description: Process RSS includes the model and runtime allocations. Parameter bytes count tensor parameters only; they are not total model runtime memory.

panels.title: Upload job duration: p95 | 5-minute estimate
panels.description: Estimated five-minute p95 of complete jobs, including validation and model loading. Bulk jobs normally take longer because they contain multiple images.

panels.title: Completed upload jobs | since app start
panels.description: Cumulative upload jobs by mode and outcome. Rejected ZIPs are job failures before image processing and do not increment image-attempt counters.

panels.title: Image failure percentage | 1-minute ratio
panels.description: Failed image attempts divided by all image attempts over one minute. No attempts means the percentage is undefined.

panels.title: Mean inference latency by mode | 5-minute mean
panels.description: Five-minute mean of successful inference timings. Excludes queue wait and differs from the complete image-attempt duration.

panels.title: Active jobs by mode | running + queued
panels.description: Running and queued upload jobs. Returns to zero after jobs finish, including failures. Five-second scraping can miss very short jobs.

panels.title: Client bucket job counts | 16 shared buckets
panels.description: Sessions are hashed into 16 buckets. Buckets can contain multiple sessions; these are job counts, not counts of unique users.
